newsitem.title: USA: Duff rates Signature Resorts note offer.
newsitem.headline: Duff rates Signature Resorts note offer.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it had assigned an initial rating of double-B-minus to Signature Resorts Inc's proposed $100-million convertible subordinated note offer.

The rating is based on the successful completion of the company's acquisition of AVCOM International Inc last autumn and the sale of 1.6 million shares, which gives Signature solid growth potential, Duff said.
Signature is also separately offering up to three million common shares, Duff said.
Signature develops timeshare resorts in North America. Its shares were down 1/2 at 36-3/4.
